fato_historico: 1985: A research assistant is injured when a package from the Unabomber addressed to a University of Michigan professor explodes.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an extra spark of drive. Much like the careful handling of fragile packages, consider how you manage your intense energy. It is a good time to redirect any external friction into a quiet, protective focus on your own goals. Trust your instincts to navigate sudden bursts of change with grace and bold courage.
frase_do_dia: Your inner fire transforms every challenge into a stepping stone toward brighter horizons.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual awareness and infinite personal possibilities.
conselho: Protect your precious energy and focus only on what truly nourishes your soul.
